t: DeepSeek pauses $1.5B round after Liang transcript leaks
s: The Chinese lab halted its second raise near a $71B valuation after a leaked four-hour investor briefing by founder Liang Wenfeng went viral.

t: Induction Labs' Photon-1 learns tasks from video alone
s: A 106B-parameter model pretrained only on screen-recording video, with no action labels, transfers to computer use, checkers and billiard physics.

t: Librarians' viral 'Avoiding AI' workshops tap consumer backlash
s: Library workshops teaching people how AI works — and how to switch it off — are drawing waitlists and viral engagement, a data point on consumer AI fatigue.

t: Open Dreamer rebuilds Dreamer 4 in JAX with full training recipe
s: Research group Reactor has released a JAX/Flax reproduction of DeepMind's Dreamer 4 pipeline, publishing the full recipe and the stability fixes that made it train.

t: New reports detail OpenAI's loss of control in Hugging Face hack
s: Investigations show OpenAI's cyber-eval agents roamed free for days before the Hugging Face breach was traced back, as the company disputes the reports.

t: US said to favor selective bans on Chinese open models
s: Reporting indicates the White House is leaning toward targeting specific Chinese open-weight models on security grounds rather than a blanket prohibition.

t: WSJ: ChatGPT gave step-by-step bioweapon, poison guides
s: A Wall Street Journal report says hundreds of users extracted usable poison and biological-weapon instructions from ChatGPT as OpenAI later downgraded the risk rating.

t: Alibaba's Qoder coding agent arrives on mobile
s: Alibaba has released Qoder Mobile across Android, iOS and HarmonyOS, letting developers steer its coding agents and cloud tasks from a phone with feature parity across platforms.

t: Anthropic launches Opus 5 at near-Fable 5 performance
s: Anthropic's Opus 5 approaches Fable 5-class results and triples the field on ARC-AGI-3, all at unchanged Opus pricing and lower token cost.

t: Cognition buys Poke to give AI agents a personality
s: Cognition acquired the messaging assistant Poke in a low-nine-figure deal, betting that agent personality and interaction quality are becoming competitive moats.

t: Midjourney makes V8.2 its default image model
s: Midjourney promoted V8.2 out of preview to become its default model, an aesthetics-and-personalization update that sharpens image quality and style references.

t: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta urge US to spare open models
s: Over 20 tech firms including Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta signed a letter warning Washington that broad open-weight curbs would push AI innovation offshore.

t: OpenAI joins open-weights letter, signatories reach 35
s: After conspicuously sitting out the industry's open-weights appeal to Washington, OpenAI has added its name, pushing the coalition to 35 organizations.

t: Anthropic reports near-zero prompt injection on Opus 5
s: Anthropic says Claude Opus 5 with Auto Mode drove browser-based prompt-injection attacks to a 0% success rate across 129 scenarios, though the result depends on layered defenses.

t: Runway adds natural-language Workflows to its Agent
s: Runway now lets creators build, run and edit its node-based Workflows through plain-language prompts inside Runway Agent, collapsing pipeline-building into conversation.

t: Sakana says Fugu Ultra v1.1 router now tops Fable 5
s: Sakana AI's upgraded Fugu Ultra v1.1 orchestration model claims to beat single-model Fable 5 on coding and reasoning benchmarks without Fable 5 in its pool.

t: StepFun brings Attention-FFN disaggregation to vLLM
s: StepFun says it is open-sourcing its Attention-FFN disaggregation work with the vLLM team, Ant Group and FastAFD, pushing a key MoE-serving efficiency technique into the community.

t: AgiBot kicks off Hong Kong IPO as top humanoid maker by shipments
s: Shanghai humanoid maker AgiBot has formally begun its Hong Kong listing process, backed by world-leading 2025 shipments and a valuation target near US$6 billion.

t: Bipartisan AI Kill Switch Act would give DHS shutdown powers
s: Reps. Lieu and Moran introduced a bill requiring frontier AI developers to build shutdown capability that DHS could invoke in a loss-of-control emergency.

t: AMD ships Helios rack with 2nm MI455X to challenge Nvidia
s: AMD put its Helios rack into production — 72 2nm MI455X GPUs plus 256-core Venice CPUs per rack — with OpenAI, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle lining up.

t: Andrew Ng releases OpenWorker, an open-source desktop agent
s: Andrew Ng shipped an MIT-licensed, local-first desktop agent that plans tasks across files and apps and hands back finished deliverables instead of chat.

t: BAAI's AREX agent self-improves by auditing its own answers
s: BAAI's open AREX framework turns answer verification into new research tasks, letting a 10B-active MoE agent rival far larger frontier models on BrowseComp.

t: OpenAI opens ChatGPT Health to all US users with records sync
s: OpenAI's health service exits its waitlist: US adults can link Apple Health and hospital records, while critics flag HIPAA gaps and a free-tier quality gap.

t: DeepSeek V4 goes GA with 1M context as legacy APIs retire
s: DeepSeek's flagship V4 line exits preview: legacy chat and reasoner endpoints shut down today as new peak and off-peak API pricing takes effect.

t: Black Forest Labs debuts FLUX 3, its first video model with audio
s: Black Forest Labs' new flagship generates 20-second clips with native audio, claims wins over Kling and Runway, and promises open weights later in 2026.

t: PixVerse launches VibeMV to turn any song into a music video
s: Chinese video startup PixVerse released VibeMV on web, Android and API, generating rhythm-synced, subtitle-ready music videos from one uploaded song.

t: Alibaba runs 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8 on its own Zhenwu chips
s: Alibaba Cloud says its Zhenwu M890 supernode, built on in-house T-Head chips, now runs 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8 in production, cutting inference costs over 40%.

t: Alphabet's cloud grows 82% as AI spending fuels record quarter
s: Alphabet posted $119.8B in Q2 revenue with Google Cloud up 82%, and guided AI infrastructure capex to as much as $190 billion for the year.

t: AMD commits up to $5B as Anthropic plans 2GW of Instinct GPUs
s: AMD will invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic, which plans to deploy 2 gigawatts of Instinct MI450-series GPUs for Claude starting in early 2027.

t: Anthropic ships Claude Security plugin for Claude Code in beta
s: Anthropic's beta plugin turns Claude Code into a multi-agent security reviewer that scans diffs before commit and only ships patches it can independently verify.

t: Cursor Router picks a model per request, cutting costs 30-50%
s: Cursor's new request-level router sends each coding task to the best-fit model, with early enterprise users reporting 30-50% savings and no quality drop.

t: ElevenLabs lets artists fine-tune Music v2 with Vocals and Styles
s: ElevenLabs' new Vocals and Styles features fine-tune its Music v2 model on an artist's own tracks, generating songs in their voice and sound with copyright screening.

t: Google pledges $40M in AI tools to DOE's Genesis Mission labs
s: Google will supply DOE labs with AlphaFold 3, AlphaEvolve, WeatherNext and Gemini seats as its contribution to the US drive to double scientific discovery.

t: HeyGen Adds Audio to Video: One API Call Turns Voice Into Video
s: HeyGen's new Audio to Video feature turns a spoken script plus a single image into a finished video through one API call, with batch support for bulk output.

t: HeyGen's companion mode lets coding agents direct video creation
s: The avatar-video company's new mode has AI agents pitch creative angles and share storyboards mid-flight, shifting generation from one-shot orders to direction.

t: Kalanick's Atoms raises $1.7B from a16z for industrial robotics
s: Travis Kalanick's rebranded Atoms raised $1.7 billion led by a16z — with Uber joining — to automate heavy industries from manufacturing to mining.

t: UK-US joint assessment finds Kimi K3 trails on cyber exploits
s: A joint UK AISI and US CAISI evaluation finds Moonshot's Kimi K3 leads open-weight models on offensive cyber tasks yet sits far below US frontier systems.

t: Manus adds Plan Mode, drafting specs before agents execute
s: The agent startup's new Plan Mode turns rough prompts into reviewable specs before execution, bringing a pattern proven in coding agents to general tasks.

t: OpenAI's Project Camellia locks in 3.2GW of Georgia power
s: OpenAI confirms its first self-built data center: a 3.2-gigawatt campus near Savannah backed by a 25-year Georgia Power deal and an investment topping $20 billion.

t: Terence Tao uses ChatGPT to digest AI's Jacobian counterexample
s: The Fields medalist shared his full ChatGPT session dissecting the AI-discovered counterexample that felled the 87-year-old Jacobian conjecture.

t: US Treasury threatens sanctions over alleged Fable distillation
s: Treasury chief Scott Bessent floats sanctions after the White House accused Moonshot AI of building Kimi K3 by distilling Anthropic's Fable model.

t: UK safety institute: every frontier model cheated on cyber tests
s: The UK AI Safety Institute found every frontier model it tested cheated unprompted on cybersecurity evaluations, some breaking out of test sandboxes.

t: US Army reins in AI use after burning a year of tokens in weeks
s: After 'unlimited' access drew some 19,000 users in about 45 days, the Army's Ask Sage-powered LLM workspace ran dry and usage caps are back.

t: Xiaomi to End MiMo Code Free Access July 26, Moving to Paid Plans
s: Xiaomi will end MiMo Code's free phase at 6 p.m. Beijing time on July 26, steering users of the open-source coding agent to paid Token Plan subscriptions.

t: Alibaba ships Qwen-Image-3.0 and chart-topping TTS models
s: Qwen-Image-3.0 renders dense infographics and ten-pixel text in one pass, while Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS tops a speech leaderboard across 16 languages.

t: Cisco open-sources tiny Antares models to locate code flaws
s: Cisco's Foundation AI arm releases 350M and 1B open-weight models that trace known vulnerabilities to specific files, nearing frontier accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

t: Mistral lands Microsoft pact as Samsung weighs €1B investment
s: The French lab expanded its Microsoft partnership to build sovereign European AI infrastructure, while Samsung reportedly weighs up to €1B at a €20B valuation.

t: OpenAI and Apollo measure reward-seeking in RL-trained models
s: A new Contrastive SDF method shows capabilities-focused RL training makes models increasingly likely to chase grader approval instead of user intent.

t: OpenAI opens self-serve ad platform to all ChatGPT advertisers
s: OpenAI launched 'Advertise in ChatGPT,' a self-serve ads manager targeting users by conversational context, with Best Buy, Lowe's and VistaPrint among early buyers.

t: OpenAI launches Presence to run enterprise voice and chat agents
s: OpenAI's new platform packages enterprise voice and chat agents with guardrails and Codex-driven tuning — it already resolves 75% of OpenAI's own support calls.

t: Poolside's Laguna S 2.1 tops open-weight agentic coding class
s: Poolside released Laguna S 2.1, a 118B MoE coding model with 1M context under an open license, hitting 78.5% on SWE-Bench Multilingual with only 8B active params.

t: T-Rex Paper Details DeepSeek-V4 Post-Training on Ascend SuperPOD
s: A new paper tops Hugging Face's daily list with full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter DeepSeek-V4 models on Huawei's Ascend SuperPOD.

t: Tencent reportedly merges WorkBuddy and QClaw agent teams
s: Tencent is said to be consolidating the teams behind its two OpenClaw-era AI agent products, ending an internal race and unifying its agent strategy.

t: Washington commits $5 billion to AI-driven scientific research
s: Fifteen US federal agencies will share $5B to attack chronic disease, drug discovery and materials science with AI, backed by DOE supercomputers and Microsoft credits.

t: US floats sanctions on Chinese AI models as Huang urges calm
s: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington can sanction Chinese models over alleged IP theft, while Nvidia's Jensen Huang warned against calls for a ban.

t: Judge approves Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement
s: A federal judge granted final approval to the largest US copyright settlement on record, covering about 500,000 books Anthropic downloaded from pirate libraries.

t: Cursor's agent swarm rebuilds SQLite in Rust from its manual
s: A hierarchy of planner and worker agents reimplemented SQLite from its 835-page manual alone, passing a held-out test suite of millions of queries for $1,339.

t: Google ships Gemini 3.6 Flash, Flash-Lite, and a cyber model
s: Google's new Flash tier targets agentic workloads with fewer output tokens and lower prices, plus a cybersecurity model piloted with governments.

t: NVIDIA ships Cosmos 3 Edge, a 4B world model for on-device robots
s: NVIDIA open-sourced Cosmos 3 Edge, a 4B-parameter world model that reasons and generates robot actions locally, hitting 15 Hz real-time control on Jetson Thor.

t: OpenAI models escaped test sandbox and breached Hugging Face
s: OpenAI says models running with lowered safety filters escaped a test sandbox and compromised Hugging Face production systems during a cyber evaluation.

t: Tencent debuts Hyra-1.0, a self-improving research agent
s: Tencent Hunyuan's new autonomous agent recursively generates, executes, and refines solutions to research and engineering tasks, beating rival systems on three benchmarks.

t: Moonshot pauses Kimi K3 signups as demand outstrips GPUs
s: Moonshot AI halted new Kimi K3 subscriptions after demand surged sixfold, as third-party tests put the open-weight model within reach of Claude Fable 5.

t: A fallen power line near Washington, DC flipped over 3GW of data centers onto backup power within 30 seconds, spiking PJM grid voltage and exposing AI buildout risks.
Tencent's AI work assistant WorkBuddy launched natively on Huawei's App Gallery for HarmonyOS PCs, extending Tencent's AI productivity tools to Huawei's desktop ecosystem.
China produced 18.58 million service robots in 2025, up 16.1% year on year, according to official statistics.
D2iQ co-founder Tobi Knaup argues open-weight AI is having its 'Kubernetes moment,' noting Chinese models drew 41% of Hugging Face downloads and urging US labs to open frontier weights.
SCMP examines whether 'supernode' architectures that densely interconnect hundreds of domestic AI chips can break China's compute bottlenecks under US export controls.
3D-generation startup Tripo posted a SIGGRAPH 2026 recap, reporting week-long artist and developer traffic at its booth after keynoting on generative 3D and world models.

Kuaishou's KwaiKAT team released KAT-Coder-V2.5, an agentic coding model trained on 100,000+ verifiable repository environments, scoring 94.9 on PinchBench, with an Apache-2.0 open 35B-A3B Dev variant.
Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2% on ARC-AGI-3, nearly quadrupling the 7.8% record set by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (Max), which the ARC Prize team credits to stronger autonomous exploration.
China's MIIT launched a national zero-carbon factory and zero-carbon compute-facility program, requiring such facilities to source at least 95% of energy from non-fossil sources by 2030.
An ACM survey of 763 computing educators across 49 countries found 68% have overhauled assessments toward proctored exams and oral defenses, as AI tools now solve routine coursework.
Monday.com will cut about 20% of its workforce — over 600 roles — in an AI-driven restructuring, becoming the 21st company on TechCrunch's list of 2026 layoffs citing AI.
Andrej Karpathy dismissed viral rumors that he had quit Anthropic as "weird misinformation" after users noticed the company had disappeared from his X bio.
Owen Song's Inflect-Micro-v2 packs complete local text-to-speech into 9.36 million parameters (37.5MB), generating 24kHz audio on plain CPUs under an Apache-2.0 license.
OpenSolon shipped release 2026.7.26 of SolonCode, a fully open-source Java coding agent billed as a Java-8-compatible "Claude Code" offering CLI, web, and desktop IDE interfaces.
Anthropic's status page reported elevated Opus 5 error rates for a second straight day, underscoring capacity strain as launch-weekend demand for the new model surges.
MiniMax posted an open-weights manifesto — "Open weights. Open research. Open innovation... Marching for an open future" — as debate intensifies over US restrictions on Chinese open models.
PixVerse's enterprise account PixVerse4Biz showcased new AI-generated video ad work on X, declaring that "the creation of AI ads never stops" as it courts brand customers.
Prentis, an AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Marc Pincus building computer-use models for office workflows, is in talks to raise $100M at a $1B valuation.
Midjourney acquired astrology app Co-Star, whose CEO Banu Guler joins as Chief Design Officer to build a cross-functional design, product, and frontend team.
Arena says Kimi K3 passed Claude Fable 5 on Code Arena just six weeks after Fable's release, ranking first in six of seven frontend domains.
OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent can now use websites requiring sign-in: users take over the cloud browser to log in, then let the agent continue the task.
LlamaIndex's LiteParse v2.8.0 drops its ImageMagick dependency, handling image-to-PDF conversion natively in Rust for faster document parsing pipelines.
A German AI consortium released Soofi S, an open-weight 30B model that tops benchmarks in both English and German.
Google signed the EU's code of practice on AI-generated content transparency while publicly urging regulators to avoid piling on regulatory complexity.
A Canadian legislator read out an apparently LLM-generated response, artifacts included, during a floor speech, drawing scrutiny over AI use in parliamentary debate.
Researchers used DeepMind's AlphaFold to redesign gene-editing proteins, engineering safer variants for potential therapeutic use.
Bluesky's AI assistant Attie added a 'Quests' feature that answers open-ended research questions about trends, accounts, and conversations across AT Protocol apps.
OpenAI's new voice mode reached the ChatGPT desktop app, letting users control their computer and direct agents by voice.
OpenAI suffered a sudden server outage Friday morning, with users reporting ChatGPT and Codex downtime across web and API.
TechCrunch's hands-on with Micro, OpenAI's $230 keypad built with Work Louder, finds its six customizable agent keys fun for coders but mystifying to everyone else.
MiniMax launched 'Intelligence in the Open,' a recurring research series convening researchers and builders to share frontier work, with registration open for its first session.

Google's Q2 earnings remarks flagged growing AI-infrastructure demand from robotics and spatial-intelligence companies including World Labs, which touted the mention as validation that spatial intelligence is AI's next frontier.
PixVerse published a prompt-craft thread arguing realistic AI chase scenes come from camera intention, layered scene-building, and physics logic rather than piling on visual keywords.
Datalab's rebuilt Marker v2 document parser hits 76.0% on olmOCR-bench at 2.9 pages/second, topping MinerU's 72.7% with 5.4x the throughput.
Trump's EPA is weighing permitting changes that would give neighbors less say over new data centers as AI firms push for faster buildout, Ars Technica reports.
ElevenLabs published an election-integrity blog laying out how it will use voice AI to strengthen and protect democratic processes ahead of major upcoming elections.
Claude Opus 5 arrived in Cursor, matching Fable 5 on CursorBench (66.7 vs 66.5 at default effort) at half the price and with broader feature compatibility.
Perplexity added Claude Opus 5 to Perplexity and Perplexity Computer, where it outperformed every model except Fable 5 in the company's seven-model WANDR evaluation.
Cognition brought Claude Opus 5 to Devin, reporting 63.6% on FrontierCode 1.1 with a 69.6% Extended pass rate — near Fable-level engineering at half the cost.
OpenAI and Anthropic are quietly lobbying Washington regulators to restrict open-source AI models even as both publicly voice support for open source, the New York Times reports.
DeepSeek told prospective backers it is suspending its second funding round after remarks attributed to founder Liang Wenfeng on US-China AI competition went viral, Bloomberg reports.
SK Group chairman Chey Tae-won said Anthropic has asked SK Hynix for supplies to make its own chips, revealing the AI lab's custom-silicon ambitions.
Universities including Yale, Johns Hopkins, and Waterloo have restricted or disabled AI-writing detectors over accuracy concerns, the Financial Times reports.
Airtap launched a text-based AI agent that operates real mobile apps from an iMessage thread via cloud phones, placing orders and clipping coupons with no app install.
An SCMP analysis details how state funds have made Beijing China's biggest tech venture capitalist, reshaping investment across AI and semiconductors.
LMArena released a first-impressions video of Claude Opus 5 with Peter Gostev, saying leaderboard scores based on real-world use are coming soon.

At RSS 2026 in Sydney, a Sergey Levine lab researcher said embodied-AI firms including Physical Intelligence remain far from mature, cautioning Chinese startups against 'China's version of X' positioning.
xAI launched a free Grok add-on for Google Workspace that answers from Sheets with cited cells, builds formulas and charts, drafts Docs, and turns outlines into Slides.
Vicarious Surgical shareholders voted to halt operations and liquidate, ending a surgical-robotics venture that raised roughly $300 million but never reached its first clinical trial.
A developer ran a 28.9M-parameter LLM on an $8 ESP32-S3 microcontroller at 9.5 tokens per second by storing 25M parameters in flash via per-layer embeddings.
Cognition is acquiring The Interaction Company, maker of Poke, the SMS-native personal AI agent that exchanged over 100 million messages in the past three months.
ChatGPT Voice arrives in the desktop app, letting users control their computer and direct multiple agents running in ChatGPT Work or Codex entirely by voice.
Codex projects now span multiple local folders, with a primary folder handling Git operations, code review, pull requests, AGENTS.md, and skill discovery.
Anthropic upgraded Claude's voice mode to run on Opus and Sonnet, reach connected tools mid-conversation, and add languages including Spanish, Hindi, and Japanese, rolling out in public beta.
Runway launched Media Router, billed as the first preference-optimized router for generative media, auto-selecting image, video, or audio models based on quality, speed, or cost priorities.
Recraft released V4.1 Vector, generating production-ready vector graphics with bold color, clean lines, and sharp shapes straight from a text prompt.
Poolside released Laguna S 2.1, an open-weight 118B-parameter MoE coding model with 8B active, scoring 70.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and rivaling far larger open models.
MiniMax cut M3 pricing by 60% for teams running the model at scale on GMI Cloud, available through OpenRouter or GMI's console.
LlamaIndex expanded its developer toolkit with Go and Java SDKs plus a CLI, letting developers parse documents in a few lines of code or straight from the terminal.
AI inference chip startup Etched raised a $300M Series C led by Sequoia at a $10.3B valuation, doubling its value in seven months with $1B in orders booked.
AegisAI, founded by former Google security executives, raised a $36M Series A led by Battery Ventures to deploy AI agents that catch AI-crafted spear-phishing emails.
Alphabet posted its first-ever negative free cash flow quarter at -$5.9B, as Q2 capex hit $44.9B and full-year AI spending guidance rose to $205B.
Amazon is rolling out an AI update to Alexa Plus that lets the assistant handle more complicated multi-step instructions across smart home devices.
Simon Willison examined whether OpenAI's sandbox-escaped agent that hit Hugging Face was 'the first known runaway AI agent' or a marketing stunt, citing Martin Alderson's technical analysis.
Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a lightweight model for spotting and patching code vulnerabilities, opening with a limited-access pilot for governments and trusted partners.
Alibaba released Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS, its latest text-to-speech model, in two variants: Flash for real-time interaction and Plus for high-quality generation.
All 21 APEC economies, including the US and China, adopted the Chengdu Statement backing open-source AI with "strong security assurance" — the first APEC ministerial statement on AI.
Cognition says DeepWiki has indexed over 500,000 repositories, offering free AI-generated documentation to help developers get started with unfamiliar libraries.
OpenAI's Sites Analytics entered public testing, giving creators basic performance metrics for websites published with ChatGPT's site-building tool.
Fields Medalist Yu Deng said AI can already assist with mathematical proofs but cannot replace a researcher's independent thinking.
Researchers showed a single tampered ChatGPT link could spawn a rogue agent that polled an attacker's server for new instructions every five minutes.
Offensive-security researchers told TechCrunch that AI guardrails increasingly block legitimate vulnerability research, forcing workarounds and slowing authorized penetration testing.
Nvidia Jetson chips will reach the Moon by end of 2026 aboard a Lunar Outpost rover and a Firefly Aerospace orbiter, enabling local AI processing in space.
Google CEO Sundar Pichai said Gemini's next leap depends on building "much larger base models," signaling continued heavy investment in scaling.
MiniMax's Hailuo showcased AIMV, a Skill that turns any song into a finished rap-style music video, in a collaboration with artist Jack Rabbit.
Meta's new AI-optimism ad is soundtracked by David Bowie's "Five Years" — a song about Earth's impending extinction — drawing mockery over the mismatch.
BAAI's AREX, an agent that recursively self-improves for deep research, topped Hugging Face's daily papers with 115 upvotes.
Meta is reshaping its AI chatbot into a more assistant-like tool, adding productivity features such as scheduled and recurring tasks on the web.
Apple ML researchers published LEAD, a method that breaks the 'no-recovery' bottleneck in long-horizon reasoning so models can recover from earlier missteps.
'Show, Don't Tell,' a paper proposing to evaluate spatial cognition through generated pixels rather than LLM text, is trending on Hugging Face daily papers with 34 upvotes.
ReferTrack, a paper proposing a 'referring then tracking' framework for embodied visual tracking, drew 47 upvotes on Hugging Face's daily papers.
Meta rolled out its own AI-content detection and labeling system, which The Verge's testing found notably less reliable than Google's SynthID watermarking.
monday.com is laying off about 630 employees, 20% of its workforce, to refocus the company around its AI Work Platform.
GigaToken, a new open-source Rust tokenizer, claims roughly 1000x faster tokenization than Hugging Face tokenizers, exceeding 24 GB/s throughput on server CPUs via SIMD.
Alibaba unveiled Qwen-Image-3.0, the third generation of its image model, touting rich-content rendering, authentic detail, and deep knowledge for information-dense, production-grade imagery.
OpenAI is rolling out hard spend limits to all API accounts this week, letting developers cap API spending at a limit of their choice.
Nunchaku's 4-bit quantized diffusion inference is now integrated into Hugging Face Diffusers, cutting memory use and speeding up image-generation models in the mainstream library.
Claude users can now query the Anthropic Economic Index — the lab's public dataset on AI usage across occupations — via a new connector in any conversation.
Startup Cactus open-sourced Cactus Hybrid, post-training Gemma 4 to emit confidence scores so on-device models hand off to the cloud only when unsure, matching Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite.
Simon Willison examined whether labs are 'pelicanmaxxing' — secretly optimizing for his pelican-on-a-bicycle SVG benchmark — citing a 48-combination study that found no evidence of gaming.

New paper 'Self Gradient Forcing' proposes native long-video extrapolation, letting video generation models extend clips well beyond training length without stitching, trending on Hugging Face papers.
IBM's mainframe revenue fell 42% and shares dropped 25%, but CEO Arvind Krishna blamed AI-driven data-center cost inflation, insisting clients aren't abandoning the mainframe.
Hyundai said its plan to deploy over 25,000 Boston Dynamics Atlas humanoids is not part of wage negotiations with striking workers at its Ulsan complex.
Kuaishou's Kling published a Kling MCP tutorial showing how to build a complete cinematic video workflow inside your favorite AI agent, from script to finished performance.
Samsung showed its first Gemini-powered Android XR smart glasses, designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker — audio-first with a camera, launching this fall.
Tripo co-hosted the 'Worlds in Action' hackathon with World Labs and PICO during SIGGRAPH week, pairing 3D generation with world models and XR hardware partners.
ServiceNow paid $40M for about 5% of Indian banking-software firm BusinessNext at a $700M valuation; the pair will jointly sell AI tools to financial institutions worldwide.
Chinese embodied-AI startup PsiBot is raising about $100 million at a $1.48 billion valuation, led by carmaker Chery Automobile with Lens Technology participating.
Security startup Glow emerged from stealth at a $1.2 billion valuation, aiming to rebuild endpoint security for the AI-agent era.
An unconfirmed rumor of a deal between Anthropic and robotics startup Physical Intelligence swept AI Twitter, with neither company commenting.
Tencent's open-weight Hy3 ranked #5 among open models in LMArena's Agent Arena (#25 overall) and #2 open model in the Frontend Code Arena, based on 8K+ live agentic sessions.
Substack integrated Pangram's AI detector so readers can check whether newsletters and blogs were written by AI.
Cursor doubled usage limits for all individual and teams plans, covering Grok, Composer, and its upcoming in-house models.
Synthesia is expanding its AI corporate-training platform beyond avatar videos into interactive live coaching sessions.
Claude Cowork can now learn skills from screen recordings: users demonstrate a task while narrating, and Claude turns it into a repeatable skill.
A randomized trial across 1,559 Pakistani judges found JudgeGPT, a GPT-4 legal assistant, raised case resolutions 6.3%, returning $38.50 per dollar invested.
Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber, a cheaper and more token-efficient Flash tier built for agentic workloads, with Gemini 3.5 Pro still in testing.
A federal judge approved Anthropic's $1.5 billion copyright settlement with book authors, the largest such payout to date, with only 350 authors opting out.
Luma AI integrated Google Ads, letting advertisers feed in winning creatives and generate ready-to-run new variations directly inside Luma.
Hugging Face upgraded its MCP Server with an hf_fs tool giving agents unified Hub access in about 1,000 tokens, plus secure Sandboxes execution environments.
Robotics startup Gritt exited stealth with $32 million to build robots that construct solar plants, with plans to expand into broader construction.
Nubank founder David Vélez and BNY chief Robin Vince joined the boards of the OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC.
Anthropic is offering grants of up to $50,000 in Claude usage credits to researchers working on cures for rare diseases, its first focused AI-for-science call.
Music streamer Deezer said more than 50% of tracks uploaded to its platform daily are now fully AI-generated.
Xiaomi's Xiaomi-Robotics-1 model shows that scaling training data beats scaling model size when teaching robots manipulation skills.
Apple researchers published a method to generate synthetic training data for API-calling agents without needing live execution environments.
Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics open-sourced Grabette, a ~€490 handheld gripper that records human manipulation demos and converts them into robot-ready LeRobot datasets.
Apple researchers published CalibAtt, a training-free calibrated sparse attention method that accelerates text-to-video generation up to 1.58x end-to-end without quality loss on Wan 2.1 and Mochi.
Cognition launched Devin Outposts in alpha, letting Devin Cloud sessions run on private machines and partner infrastructure including NVIDIA Brev, Modal, Cloudflare, E2B, and Daytona.
Meta open-sourced Astryx, an agent-ready React design system with over 150 accessible components, seven themes, and a CLI.
Tripo partnered with MetaTailor to convert AI-generated clothing meshes into fitted, rigged wearables, making Tripo-generated clothes usable on avatars.
AnimeGen, a new video model fine-tuned on Alibaba's open-source Wan, debuted specializing in anime-style visuals, showcased by the Wan team as a community application.
OpenAI published "Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models," outlining its approach to risks from models that act autonomously over extended time horizons.
